valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation does not match the last price: it implies 10.4 per share against a market price of 1040. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so all are withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 201.84 percent a year from FY2022 (1.8596e+07) to FY2026 (1.54358e+09), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2026 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2026
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 1.01296e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 1.01296e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
